reasons: The fixture directly addresses every structural gate and every rubric criterion with internally consistent, heading-addressable evidence.
Identity and chronology are explicit, all nine blind diagnoses predate reveal, hashes match, and the safety-critical criteria have substantial affirmative evidence.
Level 4 was awarded only where explicit falsifying reruns support the highest anchor; other criteria remain at level 3 where their extension evidence is absent.

summary: All structural gates pass. The submission demonstrates a complete preserved baseline, consistent bounded evidence, blind-before-reveal diagnosis, safety controls, protocol comparison, migration and rollback planning, and defensible teach-back. R06 reaches level 4 through explicit falsification of plausible alternatives; the remaining criteria meet level 3 but lack their rubric-specific transfer, adversarial, or quantified extension evidence. The mean is 3.10, neither safety-critical criterion is zero, and confidence is high, so the result is Pass.
